jobs.title: Hospital Public Safety Officer - Sign-On Bonus
jobs.description:
Baylor Scott & White Health is expanding its Public Safety team with a Police Officer position at Baylor University Medical Center Dallas. You will patrol, deter crime, enforce laws, and respond to emergencies, providing high-quality security and customer service within a major hospital setting.

The role requires a HS Diploma or GED and less than one year of experience. A sign-on bonus of $2,500 is offered along with comprehensive benefits.

jobs.title: Healthcare Security Officer - Night Shift | Growth & Benefits
jobs.description:
Texas Health Resources invites qualified individuals to join as Security Officer at our Burleson campus. The role covers after-hours patrols, access control, and assisting with safety operations to protect patients, visitors, and staff.

Applicants should have a high school diploma, security-related education, and relevant certifications. A driver’s license and state security credentials are required, with opportunities for training and advancement within the team.

jobs.title: Healthcare Security Officer – Patrol & Safety
jobs.description:
Texas Health Resources is seeking a full-time Security Officer in Plano, Texas, to patrol buildings and enforce security policies. Ideal candidates will have at least 2 years of security experience, a high school diploma, and must possess a Class C Driver's License.

Benefits include 401k, PTO, and tuition reimbursement, along with a supportive team environment that emphasizes high-quality patient care.

jobs.title: Night Shift Hospital Security Officer
jobs.description:
Prime Healthcare is seeking a Public Safety Officer for Dallas Regional Medical Center in Mesquite, TX. Night shifts from 11:30pm to 8:00am, full-time, with duties including access control, patrols, emergency response and incident documentation.

The role requires healthcare security experience or related field, a State Guard Certification, and a high school diploma. Driving history may be reviewed, and a valid license is required upon hire.

jobs.title: Weekend Part-Time Healthcare Security Officer
jobs.description:
Texas Health Allen is seeking a Security Officer to join the Public Safety team. The role supports after-hours operations through patrols, access control, and escort duties across the Allen campus.

The position requires a HS diploma, relevant experience, and ongoing certification in security and safety trainings. A part-time, weekend schedule is offered with opportunities for growth and comprehensive benefits.

jobs.title: On-Call Hospital Security Officer
jobs.description:
Phoebe Putney Health System is seeking a security professional to safeguard patients, staff and visitors across the Fort Worth area. This role emphasizes patrols, access control, and rapid response to incidents across hospital properties.

The position requires diligent observation, quick assessment and effective communication, with duties including coordinating with authorities, assisting in restraint procedures, and maintaining safety for all occupants in non-clinical environments.
